# The Second Sex

*[Beauvoir](../philosophers/beauvoir.md) · 1949*

An essay by [Simone de Beauvoir](../philosophers/beauvoir.md) that analyses, with the tools of [existentialism](../movements/existentialism.md), how woman has been constituted as man's Other. The second volume opens with the sentence "One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman".
